title: 국세물납재산취급규칙 / queue:ANNEX:0002:00:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
[Form 2-1]
Detailed Statement of Property for Payment in Kind of National Taxes (Real Property)

Location
Category
Structure or Details
Quantity
Date of Construction of Building
Rental Value
Accepted Value
History
Remarks
Won
Won
Total

Remarks:
1. In the "Category" column, state the land category for land; for buildings, state whether the property is a residence, store, office, factory, warehouse, or storage yard.
2. In the "Structure" column, for buildings state whether the structure is wooden, steel, brick/tile, stone, concrete, etc.; also state whether it is a single-story or two-story building and whether it has a basement.
3. In the "Quantity" column, state the number of pyeong for land and the floor area of each story for buildings.
4. In the "History" column, state: "Accepted from [name] on [year/month/day]."

[Form 2-2]
Detailed Statement of Property for Payment in Kind of National Taxes (Securities)

Type of Security
Number of Certificates
Face Value
Certificate Symbol/Number and Series
Accepted Value
History
Remarks
Unit Price
Total
Won
Won
Total

Remarks:
1. In the "Type of Security" column, state the type, such as shares of a specified corporation.
2. In the "History" column, state: "Accepted from [name] on [year/month/day]."
